nodes.label: Crew
nodes.desc: Pydantic model that wires agents, tasks, process mode and memory into one declarative team.

nodes.label: Crew.kickoff()
nodes.desc: Public entry point; validates config and dispatches to the process runner.

nodes.label: Process enum
nodes.desc: sequential or hierarchical; hierarchical first creates a manager agent.

nodes.label: Crew._execute_tasks()
nodes.desc: The task loop: runs tasks in order, interleaves async futures, feeds prior outputs forward as context.

nodes.label: Task._execute_core()
nodes.desc: Resolves the assigned agent, emits TaskStartedEvent, calls agent.execute_task and wraps the result in TaskOutput.

nodes.label: Agent.execute_task()
nodes.desc: Builds the role/goal/backstory prompt, merges knowledge, then drives the executor loop.

nodes.label: AgentExecutor
nodes.desc: The tool-calling agent loop, itself implemented as a Flow over AgentExecutorState.

nodes.label: LLM(BaseLLM).call
nodes.desc: Provider-neutral chat call routed through LiteLLM; BaseLLM.call defines the contract.

nodes.label: ToolUsage
nodes.desc: Executes requested tools with per-task usage limits and result caching.

nodes.label: DelegateWorkTool
nodes.desc: Manager's tool to hand work to a coworker agent, alongside AskQuestionTool.

nodes.label: Flow
nodes.desc: Event-driven orchestration: @start/@listen methods form a state graph that can kick off crews.

nodes.label: Memory
nodes.desc: Scoped record store: recall() surfaces relevant history before a task, remember() encodes results after.

edges.label: dispatch: sequential loop or manager-first hierarchy
runs each task with prior outputs as context
asks for next action or final answer
flow steps kick off embedded crews
